fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 1984 Peterbilt 359 dump truck; a truck we can detail and buff, though it is large.
findings: Copper/brown cab paint looks dull and slightly faded in spots on the hood and fenders, especially in the sunny first photo
Faded, weathered paint on the front fender arches
Hazy, dull finish on the aluminum dump box sides compared to the polished stainless
Light grime on the frame rails and fuel tank area visible from the side
Stainless air cleaner, tanks and wheels already look fairly bright and polished
message: Hi Dan, we saw your listing for the 359 dump truck. The copper paint on the hood and fenders looks a bit dull in the photos, and the aluminum box could use some brightening to match the stainless. We do mobile pre-sale washes and machine buffs and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
